cands.bio: Democratic member of the Alabama House for District 54 (Birmingham) since November 2018. U.S. Marine Corps veteran with a UAB degree in English and political science. Worked at Birmingham AIDS Outreach and as a membership services representative at MedjetAssist. Serves as House Democratic Whip.
cands.gaps: We could not find where Rafferty was born or raised, or when he came to Alabama. We found no documented actions or stated positions from him on data centers, homestead property taxes, limits on investor or foreign land buyers, growth and land conservation, H-1B or immigration enforcement, police pay or penalties, gun laws, abortion, or school choice and vouchers. He did not complete Ballotpedia's candidate survey in 2022 or 2026. His campaign site mentions Medicaid expansion, funding public schools, living wages and small business, but gives no detail that bears on these topics. His sponsored bills (HB 152, a sales tax exemption on baby formula, maternity clothing and menstrual products, and HB 291, to repeal the 2016 state law that bars local minimum wages above the federal level) come from a Wikipedia summary and do not bear on these topics.
